limitations: This certificate fixes the normalization phi_{0,1}=r^{-1}+10+r+O(q), the finite evenness checks f(n,l)=f(n,-l), and the finite discriminant-dependence checks f(n,l)=c(4n-l^2) in the first relation-closed window.
This certificate computes only the target arithmetic coefficients f(nm,l) from phi_{0,1}.
It compares those coefficients with the A071 target signed dimensions.
It includes the D_1, D_2, D_3 rows forced by the minimal nonzero downward-saturation extension.
It does not supply compact K3xE source representatives.
It does not supply even and odd parity dimensions for signed-only target rows.
It does not supply Hall brackets, pairings, radical kernels, PBW rows, or primitive recognition.
